definition.simple: When two or more atoms join together chemically, they form a molecule.
definition.academic: A group of two or more atoms that are chemically bonded together, tightly held together by attractive forces.

common_misconceptions: A molecule always has different types of atoms. (Correction: No, O2 is a molecule made of two of the *same* oxygen atoms!)
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask: Is 'O' an atom or a molecule? Is 'O2' an atom or a molecule?
